question: Find papers discussing phantom fabrication for bio tissues for imaging

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: Answer identifies Paper [0] as a review of 3D printing technologies for creating functional structures for medical phantoms and regenerated tissue/organ applications.
examples: Paper [0] reviews 3D printing of functional structures for medical phantoms and tissue regeneration
3D printing review covering phantoms and regenerated tissue applications

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: Answer identifies Paper [1] as detailing fabrication and characterization of optical tissue phantoms containing embedded macrostructures that simulate complex tissue anatomy for imaging experiments.
examples: Paper [1] fabricates and characterizes optical phantoms with macrostructures to mimic tissue anatomy

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2

examples: Paper [2] presents design and fabrication of a spherical inclusion phantom validating MR susceptibility imaging
